record.question: An old woman was hit by motor cycle while crossing the road. As a nurse who was the witness there, the first intervention that she will do is:
options: Move the person to a safer place
record.explanation: Answer B: Call for help. For a witnessed road injury, the nurse should first ensure scene safety and summon emergency help; moving or manipulating a suspected fracture can worsen injury unless the scene is unsafe. Source/context note: If the patient remains in immediate danger, move only as necessary to a safer location. Reference: https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/first-aid/first-aid-steps. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
